items.title: Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training
items.title_zh: Microfitting：通过缓存式测试时训练实现持续学习
items.summary: Microfitting trains and caches a small adapter for each document, generated from synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried, sidestepping catastrophic forgetting through parameter isolation. On DeepSeek V4 Flash it achieves a 38.2% relative improvement over the base model in Enterprise Document Operations, and the adapter-data recipe is revised over time from previous outcomes.

items.title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
items.title_zh: 深度研究 Agent 的安全：攻击面、防御、基准与针对研究规划的议程植入
items.summary: The paper systematizes security risks across retrieval, planning, evidence integration and report generation in deep research agents, reviewing 34 primary studies and finding that only 26.5% cover the planning stage. It introduces an agenda-seeding attack that introduces only a fictitious evaluation metric; across 3,520 sandboxed runs the attacker's target becomes the top pick in 16% to 28% of reports, while GEO and prompt injection are nearly ineffective.

items.title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
items.title_zh: EchoSpec：训练搜索 Agent 将证据置于回响之上
items.summary: The paper shows that reinforcement-learned search agents treat paraphrased echoes as independent sources: eight false-claim echoes overturn 58–73% of previously correct answers across five base models and seven released RL agents. EchoSpec trains a two-stage verification warm-start and group RL with an evidence-gated reward, cutting eight-echo deference by 30–44 points on Qwen2.5-7B and raising standalone QA precision to 47–55%.

items.title: CapCover Filter: Semantic Approximate Membership Queries over Embeddings
items.title_zh: CapCover Filter：面向嵌入的语义近似成员查询
items.summary: CapCover Filter summarizes a set of embeddings with spherical caps to answer semantic approximate membership queries, rejecting a query when no indexed vector meets the similarity threshold while guaranteeing no false negatives. Across five real-world datasets at a cosine threshold of 0.95 it eliminates roughly 20–100% of index accesses using 2% of raw FP32 embedding memory, improving FAISS query throughput by up to 382% and about 116% on average.

items.title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers
items.title_zh: 还需要微调分类器吗？将类型化决策模型替换进 24 篇 ACL 论文
items.summary: The authors replace the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers with TypeSafe's Jev typed decision model, keeping each paper's splits, label definitions and metric, and assemble 46 English test sets into the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark. A zero-shot prompt directly replaced the paper's predictor on 12 of the 46 test sets, while 500 training labels plus calibration and GEPA-style prompt optimization closed a median 72% of the gap to the paper's method at a median $1.66 per search.

items.title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型从医院价格透明数据估算门诊就诊价格
items.summary: The study applies a RAG framework to hospital price-transparency files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region, comparing BM25, OpenAI embedding models and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline. GPT-BM25 achieves average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for procedure groups, versus 147.98% and 82.82% without retrieval.

items.title: GEM-MM: Reducing VLM Hallucination with Entropy-Guided Preference Alignment
items.title_zh: GEM-MM：用熵引导偏好对齐降低 VLM 幻觉
items.summary: GEM-MM extends entropy-guided preference optimization to vision-language models by sampling on-policy candidates, rewarding high-entropy reasoning forks and penalizing uncertain final answers. With a 3,000-prompt MM-RLHF budget on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, it achieves the best entropy-depth preference score at 61.7% and reduces AMBER hallucination from 23.4–24.0 to 20.6 and CHAIR from 5.0–5.1 to 4.6 at matched caption coverage.
